regions.finding: The article identity and cited Crabbe, CuI/paraformaldehyde, gold/enamine, and propargylic-amine methods were inspected as background literature; they were not converted into experiments of this paper.

regions.region: lower-left Table 1 reaction drawing, six catalyst rows, footnotes, and adjacent Zn(OTf)2 prose
regions.finding: Six independent catalyst-screen rows and the separate prose Zn(OTf)2 experiment were extracted with shared scale, equivalents, solvent volume, 150 °C sealed operation, row times, yields, and isolated/NMR bases where stated.

Four explicit no-product solvent screens, the qualitative piperidine comparison, prose-described Table S3 entry 7, and the 1/3/5/7 mL concentration series were inspected. The 5 mL/65% point is merged with Table 2 entry 1; unavailable Tables S1-S3 leave unstated row details missing.

regions.region: lower-right Table 2 reaction drawing, entries 1-11, and footnotes
regions.finding: All eleven substrate-scope rows were extracted independently, including 3 versus 5 mL footnotes, sealed-tube overrides, the 150 °C override, and image-verified entry 10 values of 22 h and 56%.

regions.region: bottom-right prose leading into cross-page Scheme 1
regions.finding: The 2,3-allenol/tosylamide scope statement, isolated-yield basis, and approximately 1:1 diastereomer statement were linked to the five Scheme 1 rows completed on page 2.

unresolved: Tables S1-S3 and the advertised Supporting Information were not supplied or explicitly associated; omitted numeric results and operational details for the prose-described comparisons were not inferred.
Table 2 does not state yield basis for entries 2-11, and complex R-group structures 1c/1d and products 3ca/3df/3dg remain label-only/unverified.

regions.region: upper-left Scheme 1 and its continuation prose
regions.finding: Three propargylic-alcohol and two propargylic-tosylamide experiments were extracted row by row with concentrations/equivalents, temperatures, times, isolated yields, sealed-tube override, and approximate diastereomer ratio.

regions.region: middle-left propargylic amine 8ab paragraph and equation 1
regions.finding: Formation of 8ab was retained as a partial reported experiment; equation 1 was separated into the 0.8-equiv ZnI2 row, the 1.4-equiv ZnI2 plus 2-equiv water row, and the no-ZnI2 qualitative control.

regions.region: lower-left Scheme 2 and adjacent mechanistic prose
regions.finding: The 1-alkynyl zinc/iminium/propargylic amine/1,5-hydride-transfer pathway was classified as one proposed mechanism, not as isolated experimental batches.

regions.region: upper-right conclusion, Supporting Information notice, acknowledgments, and references
regions.finding: No additional current-paper experiment was identified. The notice says SI exists online but no SI file was supplied, so association remains unestablished; references remain background literature.

unresolved: Formation of 8ab lacks quantities, time, temperature, and yield; the no-ZnI2 control lacks a duration and numeric outcome.
Scheme 2 is explicitly tentative, and all generic mechanistic intermediates remain unverified label-only structures.
